The '''Exchange Factory Square''' was an industrial square controlled by the [[Exchange]] in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Meridian Hall]] and [[Charnax Industries]] were located in the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Exchange Factory Square appears as part of the Upper Industrial Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
